name: USDB Blast
oneLiner: USDB is Blast L2's native yield-bearing dollar, bridged USDC/USDT routed through MakerDAO DSR with auto-rebasing yield to Blast holders.
collateral: USDC and USDT bridged to Blast L2; yield from Maker DSR and T-bills
pegMechanism: Automatic rebasing with yield from underlying centralized stablecoin strategies

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: USDB is a Blast-native asset whose supply tracks stablecoins escrowed in the Ethereum USDYieldManager and minted on Blast through the L1 bridge/yield-manager path. The route is reviewed as external lock/mint infrastructure because holder-facing USDB supply depends on bridge-admin/yield-manager controls, not on issuer-native burn/mint finality.
bridgeRouteRisk.reviewer: Codex Safety Score V9 BRDG curation

protocols.name: Blast USDYieldManager
protocols.note: Route identified from existing Pharos mint-authority review and Blast/Metalayer contract docs.

routes.reviewNote: USDB is minted on Blast against stablecoins deposited through the Ethereum USDYieldManager and Blast bridge path.

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Resolved from Pharos stablecoin metadata by the blacklistability resolver through parent, reserve, custody, variant, or text-signal exposure; no separate manual override source is attached.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Inferred review retained: USDB resolves to Upstream because existing dependency, reserve, custody, variant, or text metadata links exposure to a freezable upstream asset.

mintAuthority.summary: USDB is the Blast L2 native dollar minted by the OP-stack L1 standard bridge / stablecoin yield manager. The L1 USDYieldManager is owned by a 3/5 Gnosis Safe (Blast operator multisig). USDB on Blast is an OP-stack predeploy with ProxyAdmin at the L2 standard predeploy (0x4200…0018).

controls.label: Blast USDYieldManager (L1 stablecoin escrow/yield manager)
controls.capDescription: USDB supply tracks stablecoins escrowed in the L1 bridge/yield manager; mint/burn is driven by L1 deposits and withdrawals, not a fixed cap.

routeChecks.lockboxOrEscrow: USDB supply tracks stablecoins escrowed in the L1 USDYieldManager / bridge route.
routeChecks.onchainAmountBounds: Mint/burn is driven by L1 deposits and withdrawals rather than a standalone token minter.
routeChecks.caps: No fixed cap; bridge mint capacity follows escrowed stablecoin balances in the yield manager.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: USDYieldManager owner is the separately reviewed Blast operator Safe.

controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25294780: eth_getCode(0xa230285d5683C74935aD14c446e137c8c8828438) returned contract bytecode. owner() = 0x4f72ee94b8ba3be7f886565d3583a7f636c58b05 (Blast operator Safe). Metalayer/Blast docs confirm this contract escrows stablecoins and routes yield.

controls.label: Blast operator multisig (USDYieldManager owner)

routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: Blast operator Safe owns the USDYieldManager bridge/yield route; reviewed as 3-of-5 with no modules.
routeChecks.caps: Safe can administer the bridge/yield manager route, whose mint capacity follows escrowed stablecoin balances rather than an immutable cap.

controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25294780: USDYieldManager.owner() = 0x4f72ee94b8ba3be7f886565d3583a7f636c58b05. Storage slot 0 = GnosisSafe v1.3.0 masterCopy (0xd9db270c…), slot 3 = ownerCount = 5, slot 4 = threshold = 3, slot 1 = 0 (no modules). getOwners() returned 5 addresses.

controls.label: USDB L2 ProxyAdmin owner Safe
controls.evidence: At Blast block 37610961, the USDB EIP-1967 admin slot and proxy admin() both returned 0x4200000000000000000000000000000000000018. L2 ProxyAdmin getProxyImplementation(USDB) returned 0x4ef0d788470e2feb6559b93075ec5be51dba737d and owner() returned 0xb9ca260493a0a6f9cfc1c2931faca48ac4af0937. The owner is a Gnosis Safe v1.3.0 with five owners, threshold 3, no enabled modules, and no guard; its masterCopy is 0x27b673b874cebefc9ba9f2b8b6005c6b86210da0.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25294780 (Ethereum) / Blast block 37610961: USDYieldManager owner = Blast operator Safe 0x4f72ee94b8 (5 owners, threshold 3, GnosisSafe v1.3.0, no modules). USDB on Blast is a transparent OP-stack proxy (implementation 0x4ef0d788470e2feb6559b93075ec5be51dba737d) with ProxyAdmin at predeploy 0x4200000000000000000000000000000000000018; that ProxyAdmin is owned by a separate 3-of-5 Gnosis Safe at 0xb9ca260493a0a6f9cfc1c2931faca48ac4af0937 with no enabled modules or guard. All bridge-admin and proxy-admin controls confirmed on-chain.
